thread:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY REQUEST] hotfix for auth-gateway requested by maria_fe. Target: v2.3.9 -> v2.3.10. Reason: observed auth token TTL regression causing early expiries for EU1 users. Change window: immediate. Canary: 5% for 15m. Requires 2 approvers for expedited rollout. Links: https://internal/release/3344, logs attached.

sophia_releases: ack received. Can we get short risk blurb? need 2 approvers to proceed.

maria_fe: short risk: change is a single-line fix in token refresh calculation, non-db migrating, no schema changes. Unit + e2e passed locally. Repro steps and small repro gist here: https://gist/ttl-fix

kyle_ops: oncall FYI. Any infra config changes? will this affect routing/weights?

jordan_sre: no infra change. It's code-level fix. Canary safe. I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards during canary.

raj_ml: does this affect any model auth/embedding jobs? if tokens expire, batch jobs might fail mid-run.

maria_fe: raj_ml yes it could for long-running embedding jobs in EU. suggested mitigation: pin older model-serving jobs to v2.3.9 for 30m if you have long runs, or retry logic. We can add a short note in release notes.

kyle_ops: ok. I can approve but want rollback steps prepped. Share rollback command and signal for automatic abort if error-rate > 2% or latency +200ms.

deploy-bot: Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl set image deploy/auth-gateway auth-gateway=registry.redwood/auth-gateway:v2.3.9 -n prod-eu1
```
Health check: /healthz and token-refresh endpoints. Auto-abort condition: error_rate_percent > 2 OR p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline.

sophia_releases: +1 from me. I reviewed changelog and tests. :thumbsup:

kyle_ops: +1 from me. I will be in the loop and ready to rollback. :eyes:

jordan_sre: giving a watch +1. I'll start dashboard watch now. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria_fe: thanks team. requesting expedite: production impact ongoing for EU1. Can we skip longer canary and do 5% immediate, then 25% at 10m, full at 30m if stable? Need 2 approvers for that change.

sophia_releases: approve expedite plan. Agree to 5% -> 25% -> 100% timeline as proposed.

kyle_ops: approve. Param checks and alarms set. I'm posting rollback runbook to ops-runbooks.

oncall-bot: Notice: expedited-approval granted by 2 approvers (sophia_releases, kyle_ops). Triggering rollout per plan. Canary target: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 10m -> full. Monitoring hooks enabled.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Starting canary rollout to prod-eu1: v2.3.10 -> 5% of pods. Canary window: 15m. Correlate with traces and token-refresh errors. 

maria_fe: starting deploy now. I'll post updates at 5m intervals or on anomalies.

jordan_sre: seeing canary traffic route. p50/p95 within baseline first 2m. token-refresh errors 0 -> continuing watch.

(5m)

maria_fe: canary at 6/6 pods updated in canary slice. No errors seen so far. Moving to 25% per plan.

deploy-bot: Scaling canary -> 25% at 3344109925. Rolling out additional pods.

jordan_sre: p95 +30ms, error rate 0.4% — within thresholds.

raj_ml: confirming long-running jobs unaffected so far. I'll keep a job pinned for 30m as precaution.

maria_fe: rolling remaining pods. ETA full rollout ~10m.

sophia_releases: leaving note: release-notes snippet: "auth-gateway: fix token TTL regression (v2.3.10) — recommended immediate upgrade for EU1 users experiencing premature token expiry." I'll push to release notes repo after full.

(final)

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: v2.3.10 is live to prod-eu1. No rollback triggered. Summary: canary 5m stable, 25% 10m stable, full rollout. Closing thread.

kyle_ops: great work. Will follow up in postmortem if we see any delayed failures. :tada:

maria_fe: thanks everyone. tagging release for changelog. ✅
